purpose: Local within-family provider-world transfer, conditional on passing all four unchanged Phase-5 Step-0 graph-cell gates; not generalization to other provider families

sampling.algorithm: Python random.Random using independent SHA-256-derived per-(preview_seed,battery,role,attempt) seeds; integer D, delta rounded to 6 decimals

physical_preconditions.max_approx_utilization_rule: D*(1+delta)*execution_fraction_x/(effective_IPT*period), with x=0.5, IPT=1e9 and period=0.2; no clipping or post-draw repair

eligibility.acceptance: first candidate in each role with all four graph cells FROZEN_PHASE5_STEP0_PASS_V2, no repairs or query reselection
eligibility.failure_policy: record every attempted world and per-graph failure; if any role lacks eligible candidate by cap, whole battery INCOMPLETE; no discretionary replacement
eligibility.target_population: role-stratified distribution conditional on the randomized finite-N Step-0 gate and predeclared attempt cap

requires_separate_approval: isolated Phase-5 adapter and seed registry for new worlds
prospective confirmatory sample size and stopping rule
B1 seven-method scorer and replay validated on distinct batteries
